name: Fey
source:
He is the son of Agedo, the chief of Matsurika Village.
He has a straightforward personality, is dependable, and very popular among the village girls.

He and the main character grew up together and can talk about anything, but he also has his mission as the son of the chief and the feelings that he keeps bottled up in his heart.

His beloved horse is Kalu, the older brother of the protagonist's beloved horse, Naru.

The nine fluorescent towers in the village are used to collect "fireflies," which are used to expand the light and brighten the village.

He and Ruwo, a trader who comes once every third month to trade in gems, do not see eye to eye.

—— Love Theme: Loss × First Love ——

The young man Fey, the heir to the clan chief, has a secret mission.
Another hidden tradition that has been passed down from generation to generation only to the direct male descendants of the Matsurika Village chief family.
For that mission, Fey hides his faint first love for the protagonist within his heart and tries to live alone.
However, when the protagonist learns the hidden truth, the story takes a big turn.
Tradition, destiny, and unchanging feelings tear apart a young love...
